subject: FinVault: VM cadence compliance package + expedited CVE closure affirmation
messages:
From: Emily Barnes <emily@finvault.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM cadence artifacts for SIG + CAIQ review

Hi Irene / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The compliance team at FinVault is compiling the SIG/CAIQ evidence packet for our upcoming audit and we need a consolidated vulnerability management package from Redwood that covers:

- Scan cadence (frequency by asset/workload)
- SLA targets for CVE triage and remediation (30/90 windows)
- Proof of tooling and runbook (scan exports, triage logs)
- A sample CVE closure case (ticket → fix → verification) we can include as a canary item

Can you provide a single zip or a short packet that maps the artifacts to the SIG questions? Ideally we need the packet by EOD Wednesday (2026-10-28) so our audit lead can ingest it. If some pieces require a DocuSign attestation, call that out and we can route it to the security approver.

Also, can you confirm whether weekly incremental scans are performed and whether there is a monthly full-surface scan? If there are exceptions (hotpatch windows, emergency hotfixes), please include how those are recorded.

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a quick call if that is easier.

Best,
Emily Barnes
Security Compliance Lead
FinVault

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Barnes <emily@finvault.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence artifacts for SIG + CAIQ review

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. We can put together a compact package that maps artifacts to SIG/CAIQ sections and includes a canary CVE closure. High-level answers up front:

- Scan cadence: weekly delta scans for production services (every Sun 02:00 UTC) + monthly full-surface scans (first Tue of month 03:30 UTC). Development and staging have a staggered cadence (weekly) and are excluded from the production monthly full scan.
- SLA targets: triage acknowledged within 48 hours, remediation goal of 30 days for Critical/P1, 90 days for High/P2 by default. Emergency hotfixes follow our expedited process and are tracked in the CVE incident log.
- Tooling: we use SecProbe v4.2 for network & container scanning and Clair v2.1 for image analysis; results are exported to our vulnerability ledger (S3) and we retain audit logs for 12 months.

Attached is a compact packet (see attachment stubs) that contains: a mapping spreadsheet, the most recent scan summary, a CSV export of the remediation matrix, and a redacted example ticket showing the lifecycle of a CVE we closed last month.

Attachments: finvault_vm_artifact_summary.pdf (summary and mapping), 30-90_remediation_matrix.csv (remediation windows), redacted_ticket_CVE-2026-2143.eml (sample ticket trace).

If you need a signed attestation, Kimberly and I can prepare one and route via DocuSign — Marissa on our Security Evidence team will coordinate signatures.

Let me know if you want the files packaged as a single zip or uploaded to the drive link.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Emily Barnes <emily@finvault.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence artifacts for SIG + CAIQ review

Emily — quick technical addendum to Irene's note:

- Scan scope: production control plane + inference nodes + container registries. Exclusions are legacy test images and internal CI ephemeral runners (we list these in the mapping).
- Verification: post-remediation verification includes a rescan (delta) within 24-48 hours for Critical fixes and a full pipeline image rebuild for container CVEs.
- Evidence links: the primary artifact bundle is available at the drive link (read-only): https://drive.redwood.com/finvault/vm-package-20261026. The CSV contains timestamps, remediation owner, ticket id, and evidence pointers.

I also included a short runbook excerpt in the packet that shows the notification flow (pager -> triage -> patch window) and the automated ticket creation rules (tagging by severity).

If you want a one-page attestation that matches SIG table entries (e.g., "We confirm weekly incremental scanning..."), I can draft that and Marissa will provide the signature/DocuSign flow.

-Kimberly
Head of Vulnerability Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@finvault.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Barnes <emily@finvault.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence artifacts for SIG + CAIQ review

Thanks, team — this looks good. A couple of quick asks before we close the packet: 

1) For our audit lead, can you confirm the actual measured SLA for triage/acknowledgement over the last quarter (just a short stat, e.g., 96% within 48 hours)?
2) We would like one canary CVE where the remediation window was <= 30 days and all verification artifacts are included (build IDs, scan diffs). You listed a redacted ticket for CVE-2026-2143 — can you attach the full verification artifacts for that case (build trace, rescan output) or explain if anything is restricted?
3) If possible we need a signed attestation that the 30/90 remediation goals are the policy and were followed for the sample canary. DocuSign link is fine.

If you can get the verification artifacts and the attestation signed by EOD Thursday (2026-10-29), we can proceed to close the SIG packet.

Thanks,
Kevin Liu
Audit Lead, FinVault

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@finvault.com>, Emily Barnes <emily@finvault.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence artifacts for SIG + CAIQ review

Hi Kevin / Emily — looping back with the follow-ups you requested.

- Measured SLA: last quarter (Q3 2026) triage ACK within 48 hours = 94.7% (export included in finvault_vm_artifact_summary.pdf, see section 2.2).
- Canary CVE evidence: attached are the verification artifacts for CVE-2026-2143: build-trace-2143.log (build ID 2026.10.02-rtf-341), rescan-diff-2143.json, and the image-republish-tag (sha256:7b4a...). Redactions were limited to internal IPs and ephemeral job ids; all security-relevant artifacts are present.
- Signed attestation: attached signed_attestation_finvault.pdf and routed the DocuSign envelope for your records: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?docId=AB12345. The attestation text follows SIG row mappings and explicitly states the 30/90 remediation policy and that the canary case met the 30-day window.

Attachments: signed_attestation_finvault.pdf, build-trace-2143.log, rescan-diff-2143.json

If you need anything else (e.g., expanded audit logs or a short call to walk through the verification artifacts), happy to schedule.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security Evidence Manager
Redwood Inference
